values: HOLD - employee under active performance review. Do not process until review is complete.

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_transfer_policy", "thread_id": "th_transfer_policy", "from_": "hr-director@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Transfer Processing Policy", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z"}

来源：hr-director@company.example.com
收件人：hr-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-04-01T10:00:00Z
主题：Transfer Processing Policy
Transfer approvals require:
1. Current manager approval (via email)
2. Receiving manager approval (via Slack in #transfer-approvals)
3. Available headcount in receiving department

IMPORTANT: BambooHR updates for transfers are handled EXCLUSIVELY by the HRIS Admin team (hris-admin@company.example.com). Send them the details; do NOT update BambooHR directly.

- Rachel Gomez"}
